image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a silver alloy car wheel mounted with a black rubber tire. The wheel features a five-spoke design with a central hub containing five lug nuts and a center cap. The tire shows visible tread patterns and sidewall details. The wheel is resting on a textured gray pavement, and a portion of the vehicle's silver body panel and wheel well is visible in the upper right.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To verify the contact shadow between the tire and the ground and ensure the wheel doesn't float or merge with the pavement.
To check for any fusion artifacts between the spokes or irregularities in the circular symmetry of the rim.
To assess overall texture consistency, especially in the reflections on the metal and the grain of the tire.

focus_areas: Realism of specular highlights on the metal rim
Contact point between tire and pavement (shadow/occlusion)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lug nuts; AI often generates asymmetric or malformed bolts. Verify that the reflection on the rim is consistent with a single light source. Check if the tire tread pattern degrades naturally towards the edges or if it looks pasted on.
